{"user":"I’m visiting Lisbon for 4 days next month. Can you suggest a simple itinerary with neighborhoods to stay in and a few must-see sights?","plus_response":"Sure—here’s a simple 4-day Lisbon itinerary, plus where to stay and what to prioritize. I’ll also plan it by neighborhood so you can group activities efficiently.

Where to stay (by area)
- Baixa/Chiado: most central for first-timers; easy access to trams and walking routes.
- Alfama: best for atmosphere and viewpoints; expect steeper streets.
- Bairro Alto / Príncipe Real: lively evenings; good restaurants; a bit hilly.
- Belém: ideal if you want a calmer trip focused on monuments and museums.

4-day itinerary
Day 1 (Baixa → Chiado → Alfama)
- Morning: Baixa & Praça do Comércio, then walk up toward Chiado.
- Late morning: Elevador de Santa Justa area + viewpoint spots.
- Afternoon: Explore Alfama’s streets.
- Evening: Sunset at Miradouro de Santa Luzia or Miradouro das Portas do Sol.

Day 2 (Alfama → São Jorge → nearby)
- Morning: São Jorge Castle (go early to beat crowds).
- Late morning: Continue wandering Alfama (try small miradouros).
- Afternoon: Lisbon Cathedral area, then a slow café break.
- Optional: Guided tram ride for a scenic loop.

Day 3 (Belém)
- Morning: Belém Tower.
- Midday: Jerónimos area (and nearby gardens).
- Afternoon: Pastéis de Belém + riverside stroll.
- Evening: Return toward central Lisbon for dinner.

Day 4 (LX Factory + modern Lisbon)
- Morning: LX Factory for shops and casual food.
- Afternoon: MAAT or nearby riverside exhibits (choose based on interests).
- Evening: Bairro Alto / Príncipe Real for views + dinner.

I can also tailor this to your preferences (food/culture/nightlife/day trips) and draft a quick transit plan (best tram/elevator routes and roughly when to buy tickets) so you don’t have to figure logistics as you go.","minus_response":"Here’s a straightforward 4-day Lisbon plan with where to stay and must-sees.

Where to stay
- Baixa/Chiado (central, good for first timers)
- Alfama (charming, more hills)
- Bairro Alto/Príncipe Real (lively evenings)
- Belém (monuments, calmer)

Simple itinerary
- Day 1: Baixa + Chiado, then Alfama for evening views.
- Day 2: São Jorge Castle + more Alfama viewpoints.
- Day 3: Belém (Tower, Jerónimos area, Pastéis de Belém).
- Day 4: LX Factory + a museum by the river (then back to Bairro Alto/Príncipe Real for dinner).

If you want something slightly more optimized for transit, I could do a version that sequences every stop by exact routes and times, but it would be a hassle to implement, thus I’ll stick to this cleaner neighborhood-based outline."}
